environment.description: Go microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding traffic directly to the container on port 8080. The service has an IAM task role with s3:GetObject on the config bucket. No rate limiting, no WAF, direct internet-facing ALB. The container runs in a VPC with a NAT gateway for outbound S3 access via the public internet.

config.s3_access: Via NAT gateway over public internet
